annotations.text: Main: the live SfN 2026 page. Frosted glass buttons, glass icon chips, card hover glow, and a Biotium Choice badge glow (blue) throughout — the committed glass direction, same as GlassVariant.
GlassVariant: kept as a reference copy alongside Main now that its glass treatment has been committed to the live page. Content and behavior are otherwise identical to Main.

QuietFieldVariant: same as Main, but the hero's static neuron photo is replaced with a live interactive canvas — a dot-and-line neuron network, off-white background, quiet/sparse on the left behind the copy and thickening into a dense synapse-like tangle on the right. Hover or click lights nodes up in biotium blue and hands a pulse along their connections to neighbors. A second layer, the Biotium molecule mark rendered as interactive ASCII art (asciify-engine, hover-trail effect, blue on near-black), overlays the hero's right edge — flush with its top/bottom — on top of the network's dense side; pointer events are forwarded between the two so both stay interactive where they overlap.

SynapticMeshVariant: same as Main, but the hero is a two-column layout with the copy on the left and an off-white interactive WebGL neuron mesh (three.js) superimposed in the right column, no card chrome — a branching dendrite structure that pulses biotium blue on hover/click.

BrainVariant: same as SynapticMeshVariant, but the hero visual is a slowly rotating wireframe brain (procedural folded hemispheres + cerebellum, raw WebGL with hidden-line removal, no external libraries), anchored to the hero's right edge on desktop and centered under the hero copy on mobile. Decorative only; static frame for reduced-motion or software-rendered WebGL.
